verses.t: Belated Hunting Man (to Native). "Can you kindly point out the way to the Fox and Cock Inn?"
B. H. M. "No, the Fox and Cock!"
Native. "Well, that's what we call the Barber's Arms."
Native (with a hoarse laugh). "Well, ain't the Fox and Cock the same as the Brush and Comb?"
[_Vanishes into the gloaming, leaving the B. H. M. muttering those words which are not associated with benediction, while he wearily passes on his way._
